text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(The scenery from that day, when I took on 
the race to show my resolve to defeat 
you—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(That heart from that day, when I dared to 
wish for victory—!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaahhhhh—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—It's coming back to me! I want to fight, 
I want to win. For you—!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (As many times as it takes!)

text_block_list.name: Eager Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Following Chrono Genesis and Gran 
Alegria, the key players are really 
gathering.

text_block_list.name: Race Enthusiast
text_block_list.text:
—She doesn't have an explosive, fiery 
presence, but she races like an honor 
student.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I ran it through to the end—true to my 
heart.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (...Yeah. It'll be fine, for sure.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(If it is for his sake, I can see it 
through.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(If it is for her sake, I can see it 
through.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Would you... let me aim for the Triple 
Tiara?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after her debut race concluded. 
She came to me with such a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara is the crown of glory 
awarded to an Umamusume who conquers all 
three GⅠ races on the Tiara route: the Oka 
Sho, Oaks, and Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being GⅠ races of the highest caliber, the 
generation's finest gather here for a 
battle of exceptionally high level.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far from winning a GⅠ, it's not unusual 
for girls to leave the Twinkle Series 
without winning a single race. Amidst all 
that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Winning all three GⅠ races of the Tiara 
route is a feat nothing short of 
miraculous."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I know it will be difficult. But... I... I 
want to shine bright, just like Ai-san—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I want to gather victories and make them a 
light for you— I want to collect grand 
flowers and bind together a golden 
bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or, usually so modest, had 
steeled her resolve to share this special 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's going to be a high hurdle, sure, but 
first... I want her to tackle it without 
giving up."
choice_data_list: Got it, let's give it a try

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. ...I'll do my best. 
With everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you're truly aiming to achieve 
that— you'll need the resolve to train 
relentlessly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than picking a target race, it 
might be better to devote ourselves to 
training for a while to raise our 
fundamental abilities.
choice_data_list: Let's focus on training for a while.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Flowers also start with preparing 
the soil.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Considering water retention and 
breathability, we decide the soil 
mix—carefully tailored to the environment 
and the flowers' needs.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
By doing so, many beautiful and strong 
flowers will bloom.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I, too—will take it one step at a time. 
Believing that the future will bloom.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To seize that dazzling aspiration, the 
Triple Tiara— First, I must take root in 
the soil and sprout.
